summary: Practise negotiation briefs, stakeholder engagement and clear commitment records for oil and gas work. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Corporate communications training for oil and gas professionals develops clear messages for technical, commercial and stakeholder discussions. Designed for intermediate-level commercial, contracts, procurement, project and stakeholder-facing professionals, it helps them prepare negotiation briefs, explain technical issues to different audiences and document decisions and follow-up actions. Participants practise active listening, testing proposals against requirements, aligning internal positions and planning two-way stakeholder engagement.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits oil and gas professionals who prepare or take part in commercial, operational, project or stakeholder discussions and must carry decisions through to documented action.
prerequisites: Working experience in an oil and gas role involving commercial, operational, project, procurement, contract or stakeholder discussions is recommended. No programming is required.
